gloss: damage report; report to the police

definitions.gloss: damage report; crime report; report filed with the police
definitions.explanation: A formal report submitted to the police notifying them that one has been the victim of a crime or has suffered damage or loss. Filing this report is the first step in a police investigation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{警察|けいさつ}→警察：01393_keisatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{被害届|ひがいとどけ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}した→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: I filed a report with the police.

examples.japanese: ⟦{盗難|とうなん}→盗難：04562_tounan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{遭|あ}った→遭う：09500_au⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{被害届|ひがいとどけ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}した→提出する：19644_teishutsusuru⟧。
examples.english: I was the victim of theft, so I immediately filed a police report.

examples.japanese: {被害届|ひがいとどけ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}さない→出す：01087_dasu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{保険|ほけん}→保険：01509_hoken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{請求|せいきゅう}→請求：03374_seikyuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できない→できる：00557_dekiru⟧⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: In some cases, you cannot file an insurance claim without submitting a police report.

notes:
USAGE:
Filing a {被害届|ひがいとどけ} at a police station is an important practical step in Japan when one is a victim of crime or property damage. It does not automatically trigger a criminal investigation but is often necessary for insurance claims and official records.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {被害届|ひがいとどけ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧ (to file a police report)
- {被害届|ひがいとどけ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}する→提出する：19644_teishutsusuru⟧ (to submit a police report, formal)
- {被害届|ひがいとどけ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受理|じゅり}→受理：12032_juri⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to accept a police report)
- {被害届|ひがいとどけ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{取|と}り{下|さ}げる (to withdraw a police report)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{告訴|こくそ}→告訴：08010_kokuso⟧: criminal complaint (stronger, formally requesting prosecution)
- ⟦{届出|とどけで}→届出：07555_todokede⟧: notification, report (general administrative term)
